uncertain_sources: The lecture previews flatness as coordinates with a delta metric; the chapter distinguishes pointwise local flattening from a regional zero-curvature statement.
The lecture sometimes speaks loosely of every tensor living in the tangent space; the chapter places covectors in the cotangent space and higher tensors in tensor products.
The live discussion of commuting component products is normalized by distinguishing scalar commutativity from the order of tensor slots.
Positive definiteness is restricted to the Riemannian case; Lorentzian spacetime retains nondegeneracy without positivity.
A Lorentzian null vector is explicitly distinguished from a zero eigenvector of the metric matrix.
